items.title: 67259_Big Chief Moore oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Abbadaba was a guitar player, that's a nickname, his real name is Elmer Warner. Do you know why he was Abbadaba because he called himself the Devasting Daba.

ctx.x: And later with Ellington, Fatso did, very good trumpet player. Abbadaba was a guitar player, that's a nickname, his real name is Elmer Warner. Do you know why he was Abbadaba because he called himself the Devasting Daba.
